## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: aca auth gmail --to bao writes only GMAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN_JSON and leaves every...

The system SHALL ensure that aca auth gmail --to bao writes only GMAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN_JSON and leaves every other key at secret/newsletter byte-identical, proven by a test against a fake KV v2 client.

#### Scenario: aca auth gmail --to bao writes only GMAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN_JSON and leaves every...

WHEN `add-secret-sink-abstraction-to-the-auth-cli` is implemented
THEN aca auth gmail --to bao writes only GMAIL_OAUTH_TOKEN_JSON and leaves every other key at secret/newsletter byte-identical, proven by a test against a fake KV v2 client.

### Requirement: The railway sink behaves exactly as --deploy did, and --deploy remains as a...

The system SHALL ensure that the railway sink behaves exactly as --deploy did, and --deploy remains as a deprecated alias that emits a deprecation warning for one release.

#### Scenario: The railway sink behaves exactly as --deploy did, and --deploy remains as a...

WHEN `add-secret-sink-abstraction-to-the-auth-cli` is implemented
THEN The railway sink behaves exactly as --deploy did, and --deploy remains as a deprecated alias that emits a deprecation warning for one release.

### Requirement: Gmail and YouTube OAuth flows accept --to bao with no provider-specific code...

The system SHALL ensure that gmail and YouTube OAuth flows accept --to bao with no provider-specific code changes.

#### Scenario: Gmail and YouTube OAuth flows accept --to bao with no provider-specific code...

WHEN `add-secret-sink-abstraction-to-the-auth-cli` is implemented
THEN Gmail and YouTube OAuth flows accept --to bao with no provider-specific code changes.

### Requirement: settings/deploy/railway_secrets.yaml lists SUBSTACK_SESSION_COOKIE,...

The system SHALL ensure that settings/deploy/railway_secrets.yaml lists SUBSTACK_SESSION_COOKIE, X_AUTH_TOKEN, and X_CT0.

#### Scenario: settings/deploy/railway_secrets.yaml lists SUBSTACK_SESSION_COOKIE,...

WHEN `add-secret-sink-abstraction-to-the-auth-cli` is implemented
THEN settings/deploy/railway_secrets.yaml lists SUBSTACK_SESSION_COOKIE, X_AUTH_TOKEN, and X_CT0.
